projects.label: Atlas Planner
projects.nextAction: Grow Atlas Planner as its own agent-work planning product: token runway, lifecycle history, finished-ticket evidence, and later extraction from the web atlas shell.

goal.title: Loop until strict goal satisfaction
goal.statement: Atlas Planner can run bounded agent loops that select the highest-scoring task for the current token window and stop only when layered satisfaction criteria are met.
goal.stopCondition: All layers are satisfied, verification passes, decision evidence is recorded, and the remaining next action needs David's judgment or a new explicit goal.

layers.label: Goal contract
criteria: A goal has a concrete statement.
The goal has an explicit stop condition.
The goal names layered satisfaction criteria.

layers.label: Budgeted selection
criteria: The planner reads the current usage/window snapshot.
The planner maps the window to a max Fibonacci estimate.
The planner selects the highest-scoring actionable ticket that fits the window.

layers.label: Maker/checker
criteria: The maker command and verifier command are separate.
A loop cannot mark the goal satisfied from maker output alone.

layers.label: Evidence memory
criteria: latest-report.md records the selected ticket and result.
decisions.jsonl records score, budget, reason, and deferred larger work.
state.json records enough run history for the next loop to continue.

layers.label: Human gate
criteria: The loop stops when remaining work needs David's judgment.
The loop refuses external actions without approval.
The loop asks for a new explicit goal before continuing beyond scope.
